Chapter 823: Chapter 23 Wherever the Mind Goes, It Reaches (Please Subscribe)

Beyond this world.

In the boundless void.

Lin Yuan stood quietly, his gaze serenely observing the many Demonic Divine Masters.

And all Demonic Divine Masters likewise cautiously surveyed Lin Yuan.

Lord Divine Eye, Eastern Wing Lord, and other Perfect Demon True Lords faintly sensed an endless surge of the Power of Space-Time emanating from Lin Yuan’s body, observing the Martial Ancestor as if observing the immense Boundless Void.

The majestic Power of Space-Time poured continuously towards the deep recesses of the Spatial Layers, thereby affecting the surrounding time and space, condensing out its own home field advantage.

...

It was just like the relationship between the Child of the Void and the Void Secret Realm.

The difference was that the Void Secret Realm of the Child of the Void came from the realm’s creator.

While Lin Yuan relied entirely on his own influence.

This scene made the hearts and minds of all Demonic Divine Masters on the field tremble, and in the end, they didn’t even dare to continue their furtive observations.

“The aura of the Martial Ancestor is too terrifying, in front of him, I can’t even muster up the courage to strike,” thought one Perfect Demon True Lord after another.

“Thankfully, the great Child of the Void has no intention of engaging with the Martial Ancestor, otherwise wouldn’t we just be cannon fodder?”

As Perfect Demon True Lords with mastery over numerous bizarre abilities, death was difficult even if they sought it, but once involved in a fight related to the Tenth Stage, they could only resign themselves to fate.

“Too powerful, many times stronger than what my incarnated spirit saw decades ago,” Tianzhi True Lord’s scalp exploded, subconsciously moving back, “It feels like even the great Child of the Void is somewhat inferior, I wonder if the Martial Ancestor has really stepped into the Tenth Stage?”

Thinking this, Tianzhi True Lord instinctively glanced at the Child of the Void.

Whether the Martial Ancestor had stepped into the Tenth Stage, these Perfect Demon True Lords couldn’t tell.

For both Tianzhi True Lord and Eastern Wing Lord, they could only feel the Martial Ancestor’s strength, and it would require no effort to kill them.

That was all.

And this, the Child of the Void could achieve by leveraging the power of the Void Secret Realm.

Therefore, the many Demonic Divine Masters had no way to know exactly what level the Martial Ancestor was at.

To judge the Martial Ancestor’s true power, only the Child of the Void, holder of the Void Secret Realm, could be certain.

“This…”

The Child of the Void also observed the Martial Ancestor closely in the void.

“There’s no aura of any treasure left by existences of the Tenth Stage…”

The Child of the Void thought to himself, in fact, as soon as he felt that spatial-temporal fluctuation, he believed that the possibility of the Martial Ancestor stepping into the Tenth Stage was greater than that of the Martial Ancestor coming into possession of treasures left by existences of the Tenth Stage.

Thus far, the only known Tenth Stage existence in the Boundless Void was the creator of the Void Secret Realm.

The Child of the Void, as the new holder of the Void Secret Realm, did not believe that the creator had left behind any treasures comparable to the Void Secret Realm.

Even if the Martial Ancestor fulfilled all sorts of prerequisite conditions for becoming the possessor of a Tenth Stage legacy treasure, there wouldn’t be a Tenth Stage legacy treasure available to him.

But until seeing for himself, everything was unknown; the Child of the Void only speculated those two possibilities.

“I have seen the Martial Ancestor.”

The Child of the Void bowed slightly toward Lin Yuan.

Without any aura of a treasure left by the Tenth Stage, it meant that the degree of the Power of Space-Time Lin Yuan emitted was completely on his own.

That is to say, the Martial Ancestor had indeed stepped into the Tenth Stage.

Becoming the second Tenth Stage powerhouse in the history of this Boundless Void.

Such an existence was worth the veneration of this bow from the Child of the Void.

“I have seen the Martial Ancestor.”

“I have seen the Martial Ancestor.”

“I have seen the Martial Ancestor.”

Seeing this, the other many Perfect Demon True Lords did not hesitate to follow the Child of the Void in bowing to Lin Yuan.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan swept a glance at the many Demonic Divine Masters, with no surprise whatsoever.

In the face of absolute power, any rebellion is meaningless. The more powerful the Demonic Divine Master, the clearer this truth is.

Therefore, the submission of the many Demonic Divine Masters, in Lin Yuan’s heart, was completely expected.

In fact, even if these Demonic Divine Masters didn’t submit, it wouldn’t affect Lin Yuan at all; he would simply annihilate all those who didn’t submit.

And wouldn’t all the remaining be those who submitted?

“The Martial Ancestor wishes to spread Martial Tao, and I am willing to cooperate.”

The Child of the Void immediately declared its position. Since Taiyin Sovereign was put forth as a publicly recognized powerhouse by the Martial Ancestor, that meant that the spread of Martial Tao must originate from the Martial Ancestor himself.

Under such circumstances, the Child of the Void naturally expressed its stance in a timely manner.

Although saying so.

The spread of Martial Tao would enable the beings within worlds regarded as food by the Demonic Divine Masters to grow further in strength, potentially having the capacity to rival Demonic Divine Masters in the future.

But the Child of the Void was clear in its heart, if they were to prevent the spread of Martial Tao, it was likely that the Demonic Divine Masters wouldn’t have a future, as they would be slaughtered cleanly by the Martial Ancestor.

Perhaps the Child of the Void, by harnessing the power of the Void Secret Realm, could hide in the deepest recesses of the realm and cling on to life, but for other Demonic Divine Masters, it was less certain.

At least the Boundless Void outside of the Void Secret Realm would completely become the domain of Martial Tao cultivators, and even a large portion of the Void Secret Realm itself would be occupied by the Martial Ancestor.

So, the Child of the Void simply chose to cooperate with the Martial Ancestor, because even the worst outcome would not be as bad as standing in complete opposition to the Martial Ancestor.

“To spread Martial Tao, ceding half of the domains within the Boundless Void and the Void Secret Realm will suffice.”

Lin Yuan slowly spoke, stating his demands.

“`

Actually, with Lin Yuan’s strength, even if he completely occupied the Boundless Void, neither the Child of the Void nor the numerous Demonic Divine Masters would dare to say anything.

However, doing so would not be beneficial for the development of Martial Tao itself.

Without the oppression of the Foreign Evil Gods, within the many worlds of the Boundless Void, those Martial Tao cultivators would lack pressure, and the probability of high-level Martial Tao cultivators being born would greatly decrease.

Not everyone possesses Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, able to smoothly break through with just a simple closed-door cultivation.

The vast majority of Martial Tao cultivators will be trapped before certain shackles for most of their lives; without external stimulation, they may never step into the next realm in their entire lifetime.

Of course.

Such actions from Lin Yuan would lead to the increased casualties of Martial Tao cultivators, with countless Martial Tao cultivators perishing in the struggle against the Evil Gods.

But is Lin Yuan a nanny? To fight for half the territory of this Boundless Void for all beings that are considered food, and then be responsible for their safety?

From beginning to end, Lin Yuan had only one goal.

That is to spread Martial Tao, to let as many living beings practice Martial Tao as possible, and to give birth to more high-level Martial Tao cultivators.

The importance of the latter even surpasses the former.

In Lin Yuan’s heart, as long as one Fifth Rank or Sixth Rank Martial Tao cultivator can be born, it is worth the death of a hundred thousand or even a million Fourth Rank or Fifth Rank Martial Tao cultivators.

Even if the Evil Gods in the Boundless Void could not practice Martial Tao, Lin Yuan would be more willing to shelter the Evil Gods, after all, with their average talent and aptitude, once they practiced Martial Tao, their starting point would be far beyond what the living beings within the world could compare to.

…

Just taking away half of the Boundless Void and the Void Secret Realm.

Apart from providing enough pressure for Martial Tao cultivators, stimulating Martial Tao to develop more vigorously.

Lin Yuan also had another purpose, which was to maintain the balance between the Evil Gods and Martial Tao cultivators in the Boundless Void as much as possible.

Once the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule reached the Sixth Realm, Lin Yuan could see through the essence of this Boundless Void at a glance.

That is the origin of the Evil Gods.

Evil Gods are nurtured from the Boundless Void, meaning the Evil Gods are endless.

Even if Lin Yuan had the ability to slaughter all Evil Gods, after tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of years, a new batch of Evil Gods would still be bred.

These Evil Gods are inherently powerful, even capable of reaching the Eighth Stage or Ninth Stage in a short period by devouring their own kind.

By then, the newly born Evil Gods, finding that most of the outer space is occupied by weak beings, will inevitably stir up a new war.

And Lin Yuan cannot be residing permanently in this Boundless Void, even though every descent only consumes a third of a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force.

But it would still be painful if done many times.

Therefore.

Leaving half of the territory to these Evil Gods would save Lin Yuan a lot of trouble.

At least, the Evil Gods and Martial Tao cultivators can maintain balance, and as the long years pass, under the oppression of the Evil Gods, Martial Tao cultivators will gradually become stronger, and the Evil Gods themselves also have their own territories, naturally they won’t recklessly fight to the death with Martial Tao cultivators.

“No problem.”

The Child of the Void didn’t even think about it and agreed directly.

Half of the territory of the Boundless Void, half of the territory of the Void Secret Realm.

It seems that the entire Evil God clan would lose half of their growth space, but in reality, as long as they can stabilize Martial Ancestor, a Tenth Stage existence, it’s not really a cost at all.

“There is another matter.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Child of the Void and spoke again.

“Please speak, Martial Ancestor.”

“Don’t say one matter, even if there are ten or a hundred, I agree.”

The Child of the Void put up a very low stance, almost obliging any request.

“It’s just this one thing.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; he was merely a passerby in this world, as long as the legacy of Martial Tao didn’t perish, that would be enough. Why would he have ten or a hundred matters?

“The deepest space of the Void Secret Realm should contain the remnant items of the realm’s creator, I plan to take a look.” Lin Yuan said, looking at the Child of the Void.

Once the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule reached the Sixth Realm, many secrets of this Boundless Void unfolded before Lin Yuan, including the one about the creator of the Void Secret Realm.

“The deepest space of the Secret Realm?”

The Child of the Void was stunned for a moment and then immediately nodded: “No problem.”

The deepest space of the Void Secret Realm indeed contained traces of the realm’s creator, but the Child of the Void, having observed for who knows how many tens of thousands of years, still did not understand.

Lin Yuan wanted to go and see, naturally the Child of the Void didn’t dare refuse.

“Then I will send Martial Ancestor in now.”

The Child of the Void immediately said.

The deepest space of the Void Secret Realm could only be entered by him, the holder of the realm, and no other powerful beings could enter.

“No need.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

“No need?”

The Child of the Void was somewhat puzzled; didn’t he say he wanted to go in and take a look? Why not now?

“I can go in by myself.”

Lin Yuan stepped out and disappeared on the spot.

Once Lin Yuan, who reached the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, was within this Boundless Void…

He could be anywhere his mind wished to be.
